newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Power sees North Anna 2 on line Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Power sees North Anna 2 on line Thurs.

text.p: Virginia Power Co said Wednesday it expected to return the 909 megawatt (MW) North Anna 2 nuclear power plant on line late Thursday after being shut Monday for repairs.
"We're still scheduled to come back on line late tomorrow," said a company spokesman.
The North Anna plant was shut to correct a small leak in a high-pressure steam line.
The nearby North Anna 1, rated at 911 MW, was producing at full output, the spokesman said.
The North Anna complex in Mineral, Va., is jointly owned by Virginia Power (88.4 percent) and Old Dominion Electric Co-operative (11.6 percent).
Virginia Power's interest in North Anna represents just below 12 percent of its installed generation capacity and about 17 percent of its annual electricity deliveries.
